channel.title: SSbreakingHeadlines
channel.description: This is a randomly ordered feed of the most recent entries from SSbreakingHeadlines, skipping any feeds with errors.

item.title: Iran Vows to Resist U.S. Sanctions as War Reaches Six-Month Mark
item.description: As the conflict enters its sixth month, neither side shows signs of backing down.

item.title: American recounts survival of deadly Nepal flood, describing the wave as serpent-like
item.description: Anjana Raja from California described the split-second decision she and her husband made as a 50-foot flood approached them in Nepal.

item.title: Trump announces US-Venezuela oil deal he says will reduce gas prices
item.description: President Donald Trump announced a deal with Venezuela that he claims will give the U.S. majority control of billions of barrels of oil.

item.title: Judge dismisses confession of alleged 9/11 mastermind Khalid Sheikh Mohammed
item.description: The ruling is a setback for the federal government's long-delayed prosecution of Khalid Sheikh Mohammed, accused of masterminding the 9/11 plot.
